en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a corner block of ornate late‑19th‑century apartment buildings in a European city. The corner building has a mansard roof, dormer windows, and a tower-like roof structure with a weather vane on top. Tree-lined streets, tram tracks, and pedestrians are visible in the foreground. Printed text at the top identifies the city and the street corner depicted.
